plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District
plan.subtitle: Pending cases and approval status distribution across districts for all schemes

panels.title: Total Pending Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending'

panels.title: Highest Pending Cases
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS pending FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Pending Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS pending FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Status Distribution by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" IN ('Approved', 'Disbursed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 5 Districts by Pending Applications
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS pending, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending'), 1) AS pct FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: Pending Applications by Scheme
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme", COUNT(*) AS pending FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

plan.narrative: The scholarship scheme progress reveals {{p1}} pending applications across all districts. {{p2}} district has the highest pending cases with {{p2.pending}} applications. The bar chart shows the distribution of pending cases, with {{p3.y[0][0]}} district having the most pending applications. The stacked bar chart reveals that {{p4.y[0][0]}} district has the largest proportion of pending cases relative to total applications, while {{p4.y[1][0]}} district has the highest number of approved/disbursed cases. The top 5 districts by pending cases are {{p5.District[0]}} ({{p5.pending[0]}} cases, {{p5.pct[0]}}% of total), {{p5.District[1]}} ({{p5.pending[1]}} cases, {{p5.pct[1]}}%), and {{p5.District[2]}} ({{p5.pending[2]}} cases, {{p5.pct[2]}}%). The pie chart highlights that the {{p6.x[0]}} scheme has the most pending applications, followed by {{p6.x[1]}} and {{p6.x[2]}}. These insights suggest targeted follow-ups are needed in districts with the highest pending cases.
